integrations.name: Kitty
integrations.detail: GPU-accelerated, with the Kitty graphics protocol used by Yazi previews.
integrations.note: A static Hornero Dark or Light palette keeps the terminal readable before the first generated scheme.

integrations.name: Alacritty
integrations.detail: A compact TOML configuration with live reload; Yazi image previews use the Wayland adapter through Überzug++ where configured.
integrations.note: The packaged dark/light fallback and generated color file are imported separately, so wallpaper colors can update without replacing your base config.

integrations.name: Ghostty
integrations.detail: A native Ghostty theme with a stable name that Hornero can refresh when appearance changes.
integrations.note: A packaged system fallback is available before Hornero writes the user-level wallpaper palette.
